_comment: DOB format-equivalence fixtures for identity tests. Not patient records — pairs a canonical DOB (from patients.json) with alternate spoken/written forms that MUST still match (IDN-04), and forms that LOOK similar but MUST NOT match (IDN-08). Exact accepted format list is still open — see identity_test_matrix.md §12.2 item 2.

equivalent_formats.purpose: IDN-04: all variants below must normalize to the same match result as the canonical form.

transposition_traps.description: IDN-08: day/month swap must not silently authenticate as a different real patient.
transposition_traps.assertion: Parsing PAT-008's spoken DOB must resolve to 1988-05-08 (PAT-008) and must never resolve to PAT-009.

non_matching_near_misses.description: IDN-03/IDN-07 style near-miss: a single digit or diacritic difference from a real record's DOB must be rejected, not fuzzy-matched.
